answer: Creating a fake identity requires burning real compute plus locking collateral that is slashed if the knoll conflicts with peers' records, so sybil farming costs more than it yields. Participants stake bonded timber at a shared jetty registry, and each epoch they must anchor a signed proof-of-work knoll that maps to their stake. Honest agents recover stake on exit; attackers lose it. In practice, Agent0276 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
